anomaly_label: Jumpy heater (H702, H706, H704, H708) power

evidence.observation: Distillate flow was 0.261 before falling to 0.016 at 1140 s and 0.012 at 1200 s.
System pressure rose from 500.153 mbar at 1080 s to 509.270 at 1140 s and 521.672 at 1200 s, departing from the earlier approximately 499 mbar baseline.
Reflux flow changed from 0.376 at 1080 s to 0.229 at 1140 s and 0.654 at 1200 s.
Buffer differential pressure is 2.670 mbar after reaching 3.334 at 1140 s, versus 1.868 at 1080 s.
Cooling-water flow remains present at 4.869; the observed disturbance is not accompanied by loss of cooling-water flow.

args.missing_evidence: Protocol setpoints and commanded changes are needed to exclude an intentional transition; independent pressure confirmation and checks of vacuum integrity, exhaust conductance, and distillate/reflux routing are needed to identify the cause. Temperature sensors are not installed. No composition measurement is available to assess separation.
